## Change

Describe the scoped change and why it is needed.

## Verification

Record the source SHA, Actions run link and check conclusions.
List checks that did not run and any required backend/device configuration.
For an APK handoff, include its artifact name and distinguish build results
from physical-device smoke results.

## Workflow
